verdict.rationale: bizfile's User Access feature lets the entity control who is authorized to submit online filings on its behalf. From August 2026 that access is required for Statement of Information filings, which gives a sanctioned path for authorized parties to act for the company. The evidence covers only this short description, though, and never says outright that outside providers (law firms, filing services, registered agents) can be designated through it. missing for 10: explicit documentation of third-party provider or registered-agent designation, details on how authorization is granted and revoked, any API or programmatic delegated-access rail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
